description: This file defines the BasketItem entity class used within the BasketAggregate context of the application. It includes properties for unit price, quantity, catalog item ID, and basket ID, along with methods to modify quantity with validation.

classes.name: BasketItem
classes.description: Represents an item in a shopping basket with properties for pricing and quantity, and methods to manipulate these properties.

methods.name: AddQuantity
methods.description: Increases the quantity of the basket item after validating the input is within an acceptable range.

methods.name: SetQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the basket item after validating the input is within an acceptable range.
